workstreams.name: Core intelligence
workstreams.summary: Audited baseline: provider-specific Workers AI, Anthropic text-only and Qwen streaming adapters keep credentials server-side and enforce bounded message/output sizes, fixed endpoints, redirect rejection and SSE validation; Qwen tool use is separately gated. Provider registry validates versioned provider/model metadata, task support, context/output ceilings, terms URLs, verification freshness and explicit pricing. The pure intelligence planner estimates tokens conservatively, selects routes by task/context/output/quota/cost and fits whole messages to context; free-only routing rejects unknown prices. Structured memory records carry owner/project scope, provenance, confidence, sensitivity, lifecycle and expiry; D1 repository methods and BM25 retrieval exist, and agent project-context assembly uses accepted memory/Forge knowledge as untrusted references. Knowledge chunk retrieval is accepted-only, deterministic BM25 with source citations. Evidence: docs/AEGIS_INTELLIGENCE_TOKEN_ENGINE.md, docs/AEGIS_MODEL_PROVIDERS.md, docs/AEGIS_GUARDIAN_INTELLIGENCE_CONTRACTS.md, functions/lib/intelligence-engine.mjs, functions/lib/provider-registry.mjs, functions/lib/model-provider.mjs, functions/lib/memory-substrate.mjs, functions/lib/knowledge-retrieval.mjs, functions/lib/agent-run-context.mjs and associated tests. Limits: planner is not wired into live provider routing; no durable token ledger or automatic failover; provider registry is not a universal adapter runtime; no verified free-model catalogue/quota ingestion; token counts are byte heuristics; legacy KV notes endpoint is not the structured D1 memory API; no production D1/provider secrets are configured.

workstreams.name: Engineering & agents
workstreams.summary: Audited baseline: durable agent-run API with bounded plan submission, idempotency, D1 outbox, Queue dispatch, lease/retry/dead-letter handling, cancellation and immutable plan/task-envelope records; specialist roles are labels, not running agents or permissions. The default runtime is execution: plan-only and makes no LLM, tool, filesystem, browser, shell or external API calls. A server-side capability bridge exists but is not called by the plan-only queue. Optional Qwen tooling is separately gated and exposes four fixed read-only tools with one tool round, exact Sentinel grants and active Composio connection; default Workers AI remains text-only. Workers AI, Anthropic text-only and Qwen adapters exist; OpenAI-compatible endpoint and local Ollama/LM Studio adapters remain planned. Evidence: docs/AEGIS_AGENT_ORCHESTRATION.md, docs/AEGIS_AGENT_TOOLS.md, docs/AEGIS_MODEL_PROVIDERS.md, docs/AEGIS_FORGE.md, docs/AEGIS_MCP_FORGE.md, functions/lib/agent-tools.mjs, functions/lib/model-provider.mjs, workers/runtime/index.mjs, workers/runtime/agent-capability-bridge.mjs and associated runtime/provider/Sentinel tests. Limits: AGENT_RUNS_ENABLED and provider tooling flags are not configured in production; no autonomous coding, shell, browser, file-write, generic MCP or external-action worker is enabled; no production D1/Queue deployment is verified; provider-neutral registry does not yet provide a universal adapter implementation.

workstreams.name: Security & governance
workstreams.summary: Audited baseline: signed owner/reviewer sessions with separate secrets and cookies; exact principal/capability/version/resource grants and bounded expiry; exact-operation human-always approvals bound to input digest and one-time consumption; AES-256-GCM vault secrets with key-versioned keyring, principal/provider AAD and owner/provider-scoped revocation; append-only redacted invocation audit; Sentinel policy/rate-limit/audit/approval mediation; one owner-authenticated, same-origin, fixed local read-only catalogue route. Evidence: docs/AEGIS_SECURITY_CENTRE.md, docs/AEGIS_SECURITY_SUITE.md, docs/AEGIS_CAPABILITY_GRANTS.md, docs/AEGIS_SENTINEL_COMPOSITION.md, docs/AEGIS_SENTINEL_RUNTIME_COMPOSITION.md, functions/lib/auth.mjs, functions/lib/capability-policy.mjs, functions/lib/secret-vault.mjs, functions/lib/sentinel.mjs, functions/api/sentinel/invoke.js and associated tests. Limits: D1 is not provisioned or deployed, vault keyring secrets and provider connections are not configured, and only the fixed local read-only catalogue route is exposed. No production VPN/endpoint suite exists; a post-execution audit can fail after a side effect, which must be surfaced as uncertain/audit-incomplete rather than represented as fully audited success.

workstreams.name: Avatar & voice
workstreams.summary: Audited baseline: owner-scoped companion profiles and bounded style controls; full-screen text Companion Mode; procedural WebGL2 bust with CSS fallback; renderer presence/expression/viseme inputs; uploaded-byte SHA-256 verification; transactional prepare/commit/destroy lifecycle; opt-in format-allowlisted adapter with telemetry and budgets. Evidence: docs/AEGIS_COMPANION.md, docs/AEGIS_COMPANION_RENDERER_RESEARCH.md, companion/renderer.mjs, PRs #107–#109 and workflows 44595564920 / 44595869026. Limits: production D1 and voice are not active; no imported VRM/GLB/VRMA is rendered; no mobile device benchmark is complete.

workstreams.name: Research & integrations
workstreams.summary: Audited baseline: Forge discovery and evidence/provenance lifecycle; research intake and candidate evaluation; GitHub public metadata reads and narrow Composio GitHub read-only tools; existing owner-repo inventory and reuse decisions; agent runtime, local inference, companion renderer, Ghost/T3 Code and text-to-CAD research. Evidence: docs/AEGIS_RESEARCH_INTAKE.md, docs/RESEARCH_SOURCE_REGISTER.md, docs/FORGE_INTELLIGENCE.md, docs/AEGIS_AGENT_RUNTIME_ECOSYSTEM_2026-11-19.md, docs/AEGIS_FORGE_ECOSYSTEM_INTAKE_2026-11-17.md, docs/AEGIS_AGENT_CONTROL_AND_CAD_RESEARCH_2026-11-19.md and PR #110. Limits: source review is not a formal security audit; no third-party runtime was installed; some candidate identities/licences remain held; Ghost/Phantom are distinct projects, Phantom has no root licence file in the inspected tree, and the Instagram Reel remains unconfirmed; no universal live repository watcher is implemented.

workstreams.name: Cross-platform experience
workstreams.summary: Audited baseline: one responsive browser/PWA shell with standalone manifest, SVG app icon, viewport-fit layout, responsive breakpoints, reduced-motion handling and a minimal service worker. The worker caches only the app shell/manifest/icons and a successful navigation response; authenticated API, login and MCP responses are explicitly excluded from cache. Evidence: docs/PLATFORM_COMPATIBILITY.md, manifest.webmanifest, service-worker.js, index.html and static build-progress regression checks. Limits: this is not a support certification; no real-device sign-in/chat/approval/file/voice/background/network-recovery matrix has been completed for Chromebook, iPad, iPhone or Android; no native iOS/Android app or desktop shell is released; offline support is shell-only and does not provide offline data or job execution.
